builds.name: MacNativeGames
builds.about: MacNativeGames' Odyssey port (community, early; MIT): its own runtime with the TotK settings panel (key 1: FPS graph, render size, MetalFX), 60 fps in the Wooded Kingdom at 2560x1440 on an M1 Max in its own tests; Cap, Bonneton and Wooded Kingdoms played, later ones not yet. The app ends a session after 20 minutes on purpose (longer runs of its renderer once crashed macOS's graphics driver; set 'session-minutes.txt' in 'Odyssey Data' beside the app to change it). Saves go to 'Odyssey Data' next to the app. Not built through Hermit yet.
builds.plays: the base game with update 1.3.0 or 1.4.1 (a card image or NSP holding both, or the base NSP and the update NSP)
